newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE TO BORROW $850MLN VIA PRIVATE PLACEMENTS - MINISTER.
newsitem.headline: GREECE TO BORROW $850MLN VIA PRIVATE PLACEMENTS - MINISTER.

text.p: Greece has accepted bids to borrow the equivalent of $850 million via private placements based on its Euro Medium-Term Note Programme (EMTN), said deputy Finance Minister Nikos Christodoulakis.

"A large number of private placement bids, equivalent to $1.8 billion, were submitted to the finance ministry which accepted bids equivalent to $850 million at the most favourable terms with maturities ranging from five to 20 years," he said.
This is part of Greece's $3.5 billion foreign currency borrowing in 1997, he added.
"The borrowing is considered very succesful and the state will cut its interest servicing cost and extend the maturity of the public debt," said Christodoulakis.
"The Japanese market will soon be explored for the issuance of a Samurai bond," he added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
